learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Engineering analysis: The ability to analyze complex products, processes, and systems in their field of study; to choose and apply relevant established analytical, computational, and experimental methods and correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

Engineering analysis: The ability to identify, formulate, and solve engineering problems in their specialty; to appropriately choose and apply established analytical, computational, and experimental methods; to recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial constraints.
Research and innovation: Ability to consult and apply codes of good practice and safety in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design, and research and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects, and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology, and engineering processes and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial implications of engineering practice.

Practical application of engineering: General ideas on economic, organizational, and management issues (such as project management, risk, and change management) in the industrial and business context.
Judgment formulation: Ability to collect and interpret data and manage complex concepts within their specialty, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Judgment formulation: Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers and people from other disciplines.
Continuous training: Ability to recognize the need for their own continuous training and to undertake this activity throughout their professional life independently.
Continuous training: Ability to keep up to date with new developments in science and technology.

syllabus_topics: Execution of tasks included in the Training Project
